help.Ad_Domain: E.g. corp.local. Also used when the server is empty (the domain controller is located by domain).
help.Ad_LdapServer: E.g. dc01.corp.local or ldaps://dc01.corp.local:636. Empty = domain controller located by domain.
help.Ad_ServiceUser: CORP\\svc-mdel, svc-mdel@corp.local or a DN (CN=svc-mdel,OU=…). Empty = application pool identity. Stored encrypted; never shown again.
help.Groups_Admins: E.g. CONTOSO\MDel-Admins. Changes apply within 5 minutes.
help.Exchange_ServiceUser: CORP\\svc-mdel. Empty = application pool identity. Stored encrypted; never shown again.
help.Smtp_User: Empty = no authentication. Stored encrypted; never shown again.
help.Attachments_StoragePath: Absolute server path or UNC share; the app account needs write access.
help.Retention_AttachmentsDays: Default 365. Older files are deleted automatically.
help.Retention_AuditDays: Default 365. Older entries are deleted automatically.
help.General_DefaultLanguage: For users without a saved preference and for emails.
help.General_BaseUrl: E.g. https://mdel.contoso.local – used for links in emails.
help.Groups_SystemAdmins: E.g. CONTOSO\\MDel-System. Members can open Settings and History / Audit. While empty, the account in Setup:InitialAdmins (appsettings.json) holds this role; once it is set the role comes only from the group – add yourself to the group before saving.
help.Ad_UseSsl: Recommended: encrypted connection on port 636. Required when the account is given as a DN (CN=…).
help.Ad_ValidateCertificate: Turn off only for tests with a self-signed certificate. Windows only; on Linux use LDAPTLS_REQCERT.
help.Ad_SearchBases: One OU per line, e.g. OU=Angajati,DC=corp,DC=local. Empty = whole domain. Disabled accounts are excluded.
help.Ad_ServicePassword: Stored encrypted in the database; never shown again.
